description: Datadog monitors for the Admin Moderation Dashboard. All monitors target Prometheus-style metrics exposed by the NestJS backend via OpenMetrics and ingested by the Datadog Agent.

monitors.name: [Admin Moderation] Ban action failure rate spike
[Admin Moderation] Warning action failure rate spike
[Admin Moderation] No admin moderation activity for 30 minutes
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
No successful admin moderation actions (bans, warnings, or block removals) have been recorded in the last 30 minutes. The admin moderation dashboard may be unused or the moderation pipeline may be broken.

**Actions:**
1. Verify the admin moderation dashboard is operational and accessible.
2. Check if the AdminGuard is correctly allowing admin access.
3. Verify that admin API endpoints are healthy.
4. Check for deployment or infrastructure incidents.
{{/is_alert}}
